translations.web: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?
translations.bsb: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?
translations.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
translations.asv: For what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of God?
